items: **Constitutional Provision:** Direct text, article, or clause written in the Constitution of India.
**Statutory Body:** Entity established by an Act of Parliament (e.g. NHRC, CVC, NITI Aayog), distinct from Constitutional Bodies established directly by an Article (e.g. ECI, CAG, UPSC).
**Judicial Precedent:** Binding interpretation of law established by Supreme Court rulings under Article 141.
**Primary Legal Mandate:** Enacts structured governance for Official Language, Special Directives & Constitutional Morality under relevant Part and Articles.
**Institutional Appointments:** Appointments made by President/Governor based on collegium or committee recommendations.
**Jurisdiction & Powers:** Independent investigative, advisory, or adjudicatory authority.
